title: phaseolus menispermoideus
intro: Phaseolus menispermoideus, commonly known as wild kidney bean, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus menispermoideus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardioprotective properties, which may help to prevent cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of the plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
